fact: Combining neural temporal fine structure processing, pupil-indexed listening effort, and behavioral FM thresholds accounted for 78% of the variability in multi-talker speech intelligibility.

fact: The polyproline regions form polyproline type II helices, which decrease the likelihood of the polyQ region forming a β-rich state.
source_span: Particularly , the polyproline regions form polyproline type II helices and decrease the probability of the polyQ region to form a β-rich state . Experimental studies of these models , indicate that the polyP regions form polyproline type II ( PPII ) helices [3] , [40] , [41] , which compete with the β-sheet structure of the polyQ region [40] and possibly protect against aggregation [1] , [3] , [5] , [20] , [39] , [40] , [42]–[44] . Thus , the decrease in the probability of the polyQ region to form β-sheets in XN1 may be attributed to the polyP regions that form PPII helices . That is , because the polyP regions decrease the probability of polyQ residues adopting β-strand conformations , these polypeptides have a slower rate of aggregation , which is seen in other experiments [1] , [3] , [5] , [20] , [39] , [40] , [42]–[44] .
